faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Everything visitors need to understand before importing a generated workflow.

items.question: What does Workflow AI generate?
items.answer: It generates n8n workflow export JSON from a natural-language automation request, including nodes, parameters, workflow settings, and connections.

items.question: Do users need to sign in?
items.answer: No. The landing page is designed as a full product experience, so visitors can generate, copy, and download workflows without creating an account.

items.question: Can the JSON be imported directly into n8n?
items.answer: The output is structured as n8n workflow JSON and validated before it is shown. Users still need to connect their own credentials inside n8n after import.

items.question: What kinds of workflows work best?
items.answer: It works well for webhook flows, scheduled tasks, data enrichment, CRM updates, Slack or email notifications, content pipelines, and API orchestration.

items.question: Will the model include private credentials?
items.answer: No. The generation prompt avoids real credentials and uses clear placeholders where users need to add API keys, tokens, or OAuth credentials in n8n.

items.question: How should users get better results?
items.answer: Include the trigger, apps involved, fields to read or write, branching rules, error handling expectations, and the final output destination.
